<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="fjQirRMW2KrydZetD7K0"> <mxGraphModel dx="860" dy="440" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph TB
 subgraph \"External Services\"
 GEMINI[Google Gemini API<br/>AI Reasoning Engine]
 STRANDS[Strands Agents SDK<br/>Agent Orchestration]
 end

 subgraph \"Vumbi AI Agent (TypeScript/Node.js)\"
 direction TB
 A1[⏰ Agent Scheduler<br/>Runs every 15 minutes]
 A2[🔄 Agent Loop<br/>Invoke with prompt]
 
 subgraph \"Agent Tools\"
 T1[🔍 monitorTool<br/>Scan for opportunities]
 T2[🧠 decisionTool<br/>Evaluate risk/confidence]
 T3[⚡ executeTool<br/>Execute approved actions]
 T4[📝 generateContentTool<br/>Generate content]
 T5[📈 learnTool<br/>Record outcomes]
 end
 
 A1 --> A2
 A2 --> T1
 T1 --> T2
 T2 -->|Confidence ≥ 0.8| T3
 T2 -->|Confidence < 0.8| H1[👤 Human Review Queue]
 T3 --> T4
 T4 --> T5
 T5 --> A1
 end

 subgraph \"Laravel Backend (PHP)\"
 direction TB
 B1[🚪 API Gateway<br/>/api/agent/*]
 B2[🔑 Auth Middleware<br/>API Key Validation]
 
 subgraph \"Controllers\"
 C1[📊 AnalyticsController]
 C2[🔎 SEOController]
 C3[👥 LeadsController]
 C4[📣 CampaignsController]
 C5[✍️ ContentController]
 C6[⚙️ ActionsController]
 C7[🧪 LearningController]
 end
 
 subgraph \"Database\"
 D1[(📦 Brands)]
 D2[(📈 Analytics)]
 D3[(🔍 SEO Issues)]
 D4[(👤 Leads)]
 D5[(📢 Campaigns)]
 D6[(📝 Blog Posts)]
 D7[(🔗 Affiliate Offers)]
 D8[(📋 Audit Logs)]
 end
 
 B1 --> B2
 B2 --> C1 & C2 & C3 & C4 & C5 & C6 & C7
 C1 --> D2
 C2 --> D3
 C3 --> D4
 C4 --> D5
 C5 --> D6
 C6 --> D7 & D8
 C7 --> D8
 end

 subgraph \"Human Interface\"
 H1[👤 Human Review Queue<br/>Approval/Rejection]
 H2[📊 Dashboard<br/>Monitor Agent Activity]
 end

 %% Connections
 GEMINI -->|AI Reasoning| A2
 STRANDS -->|Orchestration| A1
 
 T1 -->|GET /opportunities| B1
 T2 -->|GET /analytics| B1
 T3 -->|POST /execute| B1
 T4 -->|POST /content| B1
 T5 -->|POST /learn| B1
 
 H1 -->|Approve/Reject| T3
 H2 -->|View Logs| D8

 %% Styling
 classDef agent fill:#4CAF50,color:white,stroke:#2E7D32,stroke-width:2px
 classDef backend fill:#2196F3,color:white,stroke:#0D47A1,stroke-width:2px
 classDef database fill:#FF9800,color:white,stroke:#E65100,stroke-width:2px
 classDef external fill:#9C27B0,color:white,stroke:#4A148C,stroke-width:2px
 classDef human fill:#F44336,color:white,stroke:#B71C1C,stroke-width:2px
 
 class A1,A2,T1,T2,T3,T4,T5 agent
 class B1,B2,C1,C2,C3,C4,C5,C6,C7 backend
 class D1,D2,D3,D4,D5,D6,D7,D8 database
 class GEMINI,STRANDS external
 class H1,H2 human",
